craft_notes: Sthāyin pranaya-sama (intimacy of hate and praise both held). Triple anaphora kept; comma→colon after address turns counsel into wonder. Rejected: vocable refrain ('O, O') — doctrine-free but clutters the catalogue; dropped (music must not smuggle noise). Read aloud: counsel pauses, wonder answers.

lines: You we loathe, you we laud, with you we take counsel — O Ambikā's lord:
how lightly won, how well — the all you shouldered for us.
l4.sanskrit_cite: dviṣmas tvāṃ tvāṃ stumas tubhyaṃ mantrayāmo 'mbikāpate ativāllabhyataḥ sādhu viśvaṅ no dhṛtavān asi

reads_against.argmap: We hate you, we praise you; to you we address (tubhyam mantrayāmaḥ). → Hate and praise are both address to Ambikā's husband, who holds the all.
c1_essence: Milk-ocean Śaṅkara bowed; hate and praise both address Ambikā's husband who holds the all.
reads_against.c1_rasa: bhakti-vismaya (devotion charged with wonder); sthayibhava utsāha-in-bhakti

l2.plain_english: You we hate, you we hymn, with you we counsel — O Ambikā’s lord: lightly won, how good — the whole world you have borne for us.
l2.sanskrit_cite: dviṣmas tvāṃ tvāṃ stumas tubhyaṃ mantrayāmo 'mbikāpate ativāllabhyataḥ sādhu viśvaṅ no dhṛtavān asi
